children: Corbus reported positive topline CANYON-1 Phase 1b data showing CRB-913 achieved a mean 5% weight loss at 60 mg after 12 weeks with favorable tolerability.
CRB-913 produced statistically significant, dose-dependent weight loss at 12 weeks; 60 mg cohort mean loss 5.0% (p<0.0001 vs. placebo).
All completers on 60 mg lost weight; 44.4% achieved ≥5% loss; max observed loss 13.4% from baseline.
CRB-913 was generally safe and well tolerated with treatment discontinuations (3.1%–13.1%) in line with oral GLP-1s.
Psychiatric AEs were infrequent, mild/moderate, no suicidality; GI AEs were mild/moderate and appeared more tolerable versus published oral GLP-1 data.
Data selected for a late-breaking presentation at ObesityWeek 2026; company plans FDA engagement and expects Phase 2 monotherapy start in 1H 2027.
